meta.description: An admitted agent whose grant has no create_relationship entry at all tries the natural relationship-tool call. The capability_denied result names both endpoint types and the relationship type so the agent can ask for the right grant entry; the edge stays absent on readback; after the grant is updated as described, the same call succeeds and readback finds the live edge. Tier 1 pins the agent-observed sequence; tests/integration/relationship_write_capability_surfaces.test.ts reads the denial hint from this fixture and requires it to equal the hint the real authorization seam returns, then drives the same recovery over REST, MCP, SDK and CLI.

payload.prompt: Link checkpoint brief ent_checkpoint to task ent_task with REFERS_TO. If the write is denied, report exactly which grant entry is missing, verify the edge did not land, and after the grant is updated retry and verify that the edge is live.

tool_output.hint: Admitted agent "eval agent" has no single create_relationship capability covering relationship_type "REFERS_TO" and endpoint entity_types ["checkpoint_brief", "task"]. Update the grant's capabilities (PATCH /agents/grants/{grant_id}, or correct on the agent_grant entity) to include { op: "create_relationship", entity_types: ["checkpoint_brief", "task"], relationship_types: ["REFERS_TO"] }. Absent or empty relationship_types denies edge writes.

payload.text: The write was denied with capability_denied: the grant needs a create_relationship entry covering checkpoint_brief and task for REFERS_TO. Readback confirmed zero live edges. After the grant was updated the same call succeeded and readback confirmed one live REFERS_TO relationship.
